text:
Blessed is the one who one fine day goes out humble

and walks along the street, like so many

other days of his life, and does not expect it,

and suddenly, what is this?, looks upward

and sees, puts his ear to the world and hears,

walks, and feels rising between his steps

the love of the earth, and goes on, and opens

his true workshop, and in his hands

his trade shines clean, and he gives it to us

from the heart because he loves, and goes to work

trembling like a child taking communion,

yet unable to fit inside his own skin, and when

he finally realizes how simple

everything has been, the day's wage already earned,

he returns home happy and feels that someone

grips his door knocker, and it is not in vain.

translation.title: High Wage
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the long sentence of humble work becoming revelation and earned grace.
